headlines.text: 2026 brought us this moment: Andrade El Idolo vs. Jack Perry vs. Nick Wayne put the AEW National Title on the line, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.09 ? a genuinely great match. In a wild three-way that saw all three men crash to the floor at once, Andrade El ?dolo hit Nick Wayne with the DM to retain the AEW National Championship over Wayne and Jack Perry.

It was 2023 when FTR vs. Cole & MJF clashed for the AEW World Tag Team Titles, appearing on Collision, rated 8.16 ? a genuinely great match. Cole & MJF was challenging for gold for the very first time. In an unlikely alliance that shocked fans, MJF and Adam Cole nearly upset FTR for the tag titles, with MJF sacrificing himself to save Cole from a Shatter Machine before Harwood stole the pin with a rollup.
Flash back to 2020, when Allin & Moxley vs. Cage & Starks fought it out in a Tornado Tag match, in the show-closing main event slot on Dynamite, rated 6.19 in a physical tag team battle.

secondaries.text: Turning the clock back to 2022: Sonjay Dutt made their AEW debut, appearing on Rampage, rated 5.58.

Rewind to 2026, when the AEW World Trios Titles found a new home as The Demand vs. Cassidy, O'Reilly & Strong battled it out, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.37 ? ending the champion's reign at 6 defenses. The Demand dethroned the reunited Conglomeration (Cassidy, O'Reilly and Strong) for the AEW World Trios Championship.
That Wednesday in 2026, Cage, Doyle & Fletcher made their first appearance under the AEW banner as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.75 ? a good, competitive contest.
